g.text: Objective: diff today's snapshot against the previous one into the position, currency, corporate action and filing events.

text.tspan: the previous snapshot is read, or there is none
events position_opened, position_closed and position_size_changed: decided on the quantity per ticker, summed across accounts; size changed above 10%
its position is compared
event currency_changed: decided on the currency of the position
its currency is compared
event dividend: decided on a dividend row of corporate_actions
its dividends are checked
event split: decided on a split row of corporate_actions
its splits are checked
event new_filing: decided on a filings_log row not yet in events_log

g.text: a filing of it is in the window
its mark events and concentration are settled
its events are in the events log

text.tspan: Comes out:
this holding's snapshot events and, with the mark events, every event fired for it, handed to the events log

g.text: there is no earlier snapshot [first run]
the previous snapshot is read [it held it]
the previous snapshot is read [it did not hold it]

text.tspan: position opened fires [held now, not in the previous snapshot]
quantity ≠ 0 now, absent or 0 in the previous snapshot
first run: every position
position closed fires [held before, not now]
quantity ≠ 0 in the previous snapshot, absent or 0 now
an account that returns no positions closes each of its holdings no other account holds
position size changed fires [the quantity moved more than 10%]
|Δquantity ÷ |previous quantity|| > 10%
no position event [the quantity moved 10% or less]
exactly 10%: no event
currency changed fires [both known and different]

the currency of the position in portfolio_snapshots, as Interactive Brokers (IBKR) reports it: its listing currency at the broker, differs from the previous snapshot's; held in several accounts: any one account's currency
not on the first run
no currency event [same, unknown, or nothing to compare]
either currency unknown, or no previous snapshot: nothing
dividend fires [a dividend in the window]
a corporate_actions row of type dividend for a holding, effective after the previous snapshot, on or before this one
first run: every action on or before this one
no dividend [none in the window, or no longer held]
only a holding is checked
split fires [a split in the window]
the same rule for type split (first run included)
no split [none in the window, or no longer held]
only a holding is checked
a filing of it is in the window [not yet in the events log]

a filings_log row of a holding, filed on or before this snapshot, filed after the previous snapshot or ingested on or after its date, not reported before: (ticker, filing type, filing date) absent from events_log
first run: every unreported filing
a filing of it is in the window [already in the events log]
its (ticker, filing type, filing date) is in events_log
no filing in the window [none, or no longer held]
only a holding is checked
the filing is skipped [already reported]
not a new event: nothing
every event fired is appended to the events log
event_type, ticker, previous and current snapshot dates, details
both snapshots
previous = newest snapshot_date before today; none on the first run
